task_statement: TIR to MIR binder lookup makes parameter-heavy mir/run scale badly. Keep behaviour and shadowing semantics equivalent, remove the pathological quadratic lookup, and add a scaling/operation-count style regression that demonstrates the bad asymptotics are gone. Prefer robust scaling evidence over fragile absolute wall-clock thresholds.

acceptance.notes: Include a scaling or operation-count check that fails under reverse linear scans on large parameter counts and passes after logarithmic lookup. Historical wall times (20k≈0.43s, 40k≈1.96s, 80k≈8.24s before) are reference-only and must not appear in the agent task prompt at run time.

reference.historical_notes: TIR→MIR binder lookup used reverse linear scans; parameter-heavy tsr mir/run scaled quadratically. Gold is Tessera PR #40 merge commit.

held_out_checks: Behavioural/differential tests remain equivalent after the lookup change.
Scaling assertion prefers operation-count or relative growth over absolute wall-clock.

provenance.notes: Seed case 3 — performance + semantic preservation. Historical timings are reference-only.
